# Pooling diagnostic — what the ranking scoreboard measures

**Post-result, additive, refits nothing.** Generated by `src/pooling_diagnostic.py` from frozen forecast artifacts. The registered phase-mean AUC in `representation_study.yaml` and the 99-control randomization in `latent_k1_confirmation.yaml` are unchanged and their verdicts stand. See `reports/AMENDMENTS.md`.

## `tail_classical_forecasts.parquet`

5,592 origins over 24 annual folds. Fold event rate ranges **0.000 – 0.808** (sd 0.181); 4 folds contain no event at all. Most (event, non-event) pairs in the pooled statistic therefore straddle two different years.

| score | registered phase-mean AUC | within-fold AUC | beats the no-within-year-information ceiling? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `p_benchmark` — RV-history ridge logistic (registered benchmark) | 0.8704 | 0.7034 (100 cells) | **yes** |
| `p_rv_percentile` — trailing-RV percentile | 0.8111 | 0.6931 (100 cells) | **no** |
| `p_hmm_platt` — Platt-calibrated HMM state probability | 0.8294 | 0.7314 (100 cells) | **no** |
| `p_hmm_augmented` — benchmark + calibrated HMM | 0.8714 | 0.7041 (100 cells) | **yes** |
| *fold-constant oracle (zero within-year information)* | **0.8317** | 0.5000 by construction | — |
| *same, prior-folds only (no look-ahead)* | 0.5072 | — | — |

## `latent_k1_confirmation_forecasts.parquet`

5,592 origins over 24 annual folds. Fold event rate ranges **0.000 – 0.808** (sd 0.181); 4 folds contain no event at all. Most (event, non-event) pairs in the pooled statistic therefore straddle two different years.

| score | registered phase-mean AUC | within-fold AUC | beats the no-within-year-information ceiling? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `p_latent_sparse_k1_99` — TiRex latent sparse k=1 (99-control rung) | 0.8153 | 0.6770 (100 cells) | **no** |
| *fold-constant oracle (zero within-year information)* | **0.8317** | 0.5000 by construction | — |
| *same, prior-folds only (no look-ahead)* | 0.5072 | — | — |

## How to read this

The fold-constant oracle is **not a forecast** — it reads the fold's own realized event rate. It is a ceiling on how much of the registered statistic is available from between-fold variation alone. The prior-folds-only row shows that this information is not actually forecastable: it sits at chance. So a model scoring below the oracle is not thereby cheating; it is being measured by a statistic whose bulk is not about the thing the study is testing.

The within-fold column is the part that *is* about the representation: can this score rank one day above another day in the same year? Every score loses a great deal there, and the ordering is not preserved.

Nothing here refutes a registered verdict. It changes what the headline AUC numbers should be taken to mean, and it means a future ranking protocol should stratify within fold before comparing.
